articles.title: Arkansas Sues Kalshi, Joining a Growing List of States Targeting Prediction Markets
articles.description: Attorney General Tim Griffin said betting on "whether the Razorbacks win or lose" is gambling, and wants restitution, penalties and taxes.

articles.title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
articles.description: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it’s about Bitcoin maintenance.

articles.title: ChatGPT Is Getting a GIF Maker Powered by OpenAI's Unannounced Images 2.6 Model
articles.description: OpenAI is rolling out animated GIF creation in ChatGPT, with frame-by-frame editing and speed controls.

articles.title: Google Tells Schools They Can Reject AI—But They'll Lose Search, Too
articles.description: Google is giving schools more control over Gemini, but districts that want Search without AI are out of luck, fueling accusations that the company is pressuring educators into adopting AI.

articles.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
articles.description: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

articles.title: US Bank Regulator Issues First AI Framework as Banks Battle Rogue Agents
articles.description: The OCC's first examiner guide weighs autonomy and financial harm, and directly addresses outside AI agents—the same risk that recently prompted major banks to restrict customer-account access.

articles.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
articles.description: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.

articles.title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
articles.description: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

articles.title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto
articles.description: Coinbase's x402 protocol puts the web's long-unused 402 code to work so AI agents and apps can pay for APIs and data in stablecoins like USDC.

articles.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
articles.description: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
articles.description: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.

articles.title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
articles.description: Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries into tokenized form through the newly launched DTCC Tokenization Service, which 20 Wall Street firms have signed up to use.

articles.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
articles.description: The French bank said the attack allowed "fraudulent operations" but did not mention crypto, and is still assessing the amounts.

articles.title: Morning Minute: CFTC Clears Stock Perps, Gets Sued the Same Day
articles.description: Plus, pro-crypto spending largely failed to produce results as the Democrats swept the Senate and House in Midterms.

articles.title: Bitcoin Shrugs Off Midterms as Experts Say Democratic Sweep Was 'Priced In'
articles.description: Experts say the Democratic sweep was largely priced in, but it makes the road ahead harder for crypto policy.

articles.title: USDC Issuer Circle Quietly Cuts 5% of Staff in Profitable Quarter
articles.description: The USDC issuer disclosed the cuts in its earnings release, booking $9.1 million in restructuring costs as reserve income fell 8%.

articles.title: Midterms Blue Wave Makes $917K for One Polymarket Trader, If Alaska Doesn’t Flip
articles.description: A Polymarket trader topped the prediction market’s leaderboard after Democrats swept the US midterms, but Alaska could still flip it.

articles.title: Judge Orders Bitcoin Wallet Returned to Family of Convicted Canadian Killer
articles.description: A Nova Scotia judge found prosecutors failed to link William Sandeson's Bitcoin to the 2015 murder of fellow student Taylor Samson.

articles.title: OpenAI Wants to Rebrand AI Data Centers, Use Them to 'Protect the Grid'
articles.description: The ChatGPT maker says future facilities could ease pressure on power grids by cutting demand during emergencies.

articles.title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, CEO Says—About 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
articles.description: Paolo Ardoino told the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano the company owns “give or take 150,000 Bitcoin,” but its Q3 reserve report implies just 100,060.

articles.title: Anthropic's AI Is Getting Cheaper to Use. That's Becoming a Problem for Its Business
articles.description: Claude's prices are falling, but Anthropic's computing expenses grew faster than sales in the latest quarter—a tricky equation ahead of its IPO.

articles.title: CrowdStrike Launches AI Agent 'Kill Switch,' Plans to Acquire Fiddler AI
articles.description: CrowdStrike's new kill switch lets security teams cut off unauthorized AI agents through a gateway, while its planned Fiddler acquisition aims to make autonomous software easier to monitor and audit.

articles.title: Justin Sun Accuses Trump-Backed World Liberty of Using UAE Ties to Escape Federal Court
articles.description: Tron founder Justin Sun said he has asked a federal court to sanction World Liberty Financial, alleging the Trump family-backed venture delayed disclosing UAE ties that could defeat federal jurisdiction over his lawsuit.

articles.title: Crypto Docs Host GitBook Hit by AI Agent Security Breach, Urges Users to Rotate Keys
articles.description: GitBook says attackers accessed infrastructure credentials in an AI-assisted breach, prompting a shutdown and emergency token resets.

articles.title: CFTC Lets Traders Bet on Stocks With Crypto-Style Perpetual Futures
articles.description: Chairman Michael Selig said “equity perpetual futures” can now trade on CFTC-registered exchanges, extending a crypto-native instrument to traditional stocks.

articles.title: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
articles.description: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won't pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals on the exchange remain frozen with no restart date.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
articles.description: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, Lam Research, and SoFi objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 56.

articles.title: Five Ways North Korea Breaks Into Crypto Firms—and How Binance Was Hacked
articles.description: From AI deepfakes to poisoning code libraries: here's how North Korean hackers get inside crypto companies.

articles.title: Epidemic of Hacked Freezers Spreads Across Europe
articles.description: A suspected hacking wave has pushed supermarket freezers into defrost mode across ten European countries, with temperatures reportedly hitting 50°C. Nobody knows who's behind it or why it spread.

articles.title: UK Says AI-Powered Ransomware Attack on Critical Infrastructure 'Highly Likely' by 2028
articles.description: The National Cyber Security Centre said AI will expose security flaws "tolerated for far too long," and called time on "tech on the cheap."

articles.title: Ethereum Privacy Network Aztec Rolls Out Major Security and Speed Upgrade
articles.description: The “Tierra” upgrade resolves a critical bug from the prior version, adds formal verification, and an AI-powered testing harness.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish for Ethereum
articles.description: Meanwhile, both the BTC ETFs and ETH ETFs bleed outflows in the Binance hack aftermath, dragging down prices.

articles.title: Binance Misses Monthly Luna Classic Burn for First Time Since 2023
articles.description: LUNC holders are waiting for Binance’s November burn, but it hasn’t arrived as the exchange recovers from a record $6.3 billion hack.

articles.title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit
articles.description: Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the sidechain's defenses have been hardened, and warned developers not to trust AI-suggested fixes blindly.

articles.title: North Korea Denies $6.3B Binance Hack, Calls FBI Finding a 'Political Provocation'
articles.description: Kim Yo Jong suggested the U.S. itself could be behind the theft, as Binance said hourly deposits had begun to exceed withdrawals.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.5, GPT 6.2 Astra Could Be Right Around the Corner, Leaks Suggest
articles.description: Users say Claude is routing some requests to a stronger unreleased model, a Mythos 5.5 label appeared in Anthropic’s site code, and OpenAI appears to be testing GPT-6.2 Astra.
